classification.difficultyReason: Group the eight marked sectors into four straight-angle complements and subtract the inner quadrilateral's total rather than seeking individual angle measures.

content.prompt: Find the sum of all eight blue angles in the figure below.

spec.description: Outer quadrilateral and inscribed quadrilateral, with two separate blue sectors at each inner vertex. Coordinate names are construction-only and are not printed.
spec.mathematics: Each inner vertex lies on an outer side. Its inner angle and two blue angles form a straight angle.
spec.answerVisibility: No answer or numerical angle measures supplied.

answer.short:
$360^{\circ}$

Subtract the inner quadrilateral's angle sum from four straight angles.
answer.worked:
At each vertex of the inner quadrilateral, the two blue angles and the inner angle sum to $180^{\circ}$. The inner quadrilateral's angles sum to $360^{\circ}$.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Sum of blue angles}&=4\times180^{\circ}-360^{\circ}\\\text{Sum of blue angles}&=360^{\circ}\end{align*}$$
